scope: Frozen 14 action records, all 745 ledger passages and the fixed 100-source frame; offline prioritisation only
development_exposure: Existing cases and error patterns were seen during development; this is not held-out validation
aggregation: Maximum within correlated dimensions, sum across dimensions capped at 100; filing priority is the maximum, not a sum of repeated passages
shared_blockers: Independent QA, first-public timing and security eligibility remain separate global gates; missing evidence is not treated as an erroneous interpretation
hard_integrity_failures: Stop on source/hash/policy identity failures; do not convert corruption into a low-confidence score
audit_sampling: Recorded random seed with independent hash ranks; without replacement within below-threshold discovery-hit and fixed-control strata
priority_backlog: Flagged but unselected filings stay withheld in backlog; no automatic acceptance
review_blinding: Separate source-only packets with no proposed labels, scores or sampling strata; operator queue retained separately
calibration_requirements: Freeze scoring before independent labels; keep calibration/development feedback separate from untouched evaluation; evaluate audited lower-risk cases and controls as well as priority cases
accuracy_estimation: No accuracy, selective-risk, precision, recall or calibration guarantee from this initial batch; targeted selection is not a population accuracy estimate

method_references.title: Optimal Strategies for Reject Option Classifiers
On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks

reference_scope: Conceptual motivation for selective review and calibration; no claim that the handcrafted score inherits theoretical guarantees
